Casey “Hundred Percent”

Mini-boss · Solo fixer · Afterlife

An ex-solo who earned the nickname by never failing a job. Now hands out work from a corner table at the Afterlife and tests new faces personally.

Tactics: Kerenzikov, +2 Initiative. Fires bursts, falls back to cover, never plays the hero.

HP 45 · Seriously Wounded 23 · Death Save 7

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
